description.value: Lavash Seaside Grill is a family-owned restaurant nestled in historic Steveston Village on the Richmond waterfront, blending West Coast staples like fish and chips with house Persian dishes drawn from generational family recipes. The menu leans on fresh, locally sourced ingredients, and the seaside setting offers a relaxed atmosphere well-suited to a mid-ride meal. Live music runs every Saturday, and the kitchen accommodates group bookings, making it a social stop as well as a practical one.
